description: Dev-only demo reliability pack: feature-flagged demo toolbar with pack loader for pack_01_clean and pack_02_missing_rea, plus a demo checklist. No deletion/reset via HTTP in slice 1.

userStories.title: Load A Demo Pack
userStories.description: As a demo operator, I can load a known fixture pack and land in the created matter so I can start a demo quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Demo toolbar does not render unless demo flag is enabled.
With demo flag enabled, operator can load pack_01_clean and the system creates a fresh matter and navigates to it.
With demo flag enabled, operator can load pack_02_missing_rea and the system creates a fresh matter and navigates to it.

userStories.title: Run The Demo Twice Without Cleanup
userStories.description: As a demo operator, I can run the same demo twice in a row without manual cleanup because each run starts from a fresh seeded matter.
acceptanceCriteria: Loading a pack twice creates two distinct matters; no deletion/reset is required to re-run.
No destructive reset/delete endpoints are used or required in this PRD.

userStories.title: Follow A Demo Checklist
userStories.description: As a demo operator, I have a short checklist that makes the demo repeatable and reduces tribal knowledge.
acceptanceCriteria: Checklist matches the operator flow for loading packs and running Quick Start.
